form.editSubtitle: Update a tracked source and keep its project assignments in sync.
form.createSubtitle: Add a new source, classify it, and assign it to the projects it should power.
form.redditKindHelp: Only used to interpret a bare word below (e.g. "ev" as a subreddit vs. a search term). Prefixed input (r/..., u/...) and full reddit.com URLs are unambiguous either way.
form.facebookKindHelp: Only used to interpret a bare slug below (page vs. personal profile) - Facebook uses the same URL shape for both. Groups, search, and full profile.php/people/... URLs are unambiguous either way. Requires APIFY API TOKEN.

urlPlaceholders.reddit: r/subreddit, u/username, a search term, or a reddit.com URL
urlPlaceholders.linkedin: Company/profile slug, a search phrase, or a linkedin.com URL
urlPlaceholders.threads: Handle (without @), a search phrase, or a threads.com URL
urlPlaceholders.facebook: Page/group/profile slug, a search phrase, or a facebook.com URL
urlPlaceholders.instagram: Handle (without @), a hashtag, a search phrase, or an instagram.com URL

form.statusHelp: Disable this source to keep it in the library without using it in pipelines.
form.reachHelp: Limited sources stay out of the assignable list on project create/edit pages unless already attached to that project.
form.assignTitle: Choose the projects this source should power
form.noProjectsHint: Create a project first, then come back to assign this source.
form.noMatchingProjectsHint: Try a different search term in this assignment box.
form.discardMessage: You have unsaved changes on this source. If you cancel now, all edits on this page will be lost.
form.redditSubredditSearchHelp: Enter the subreddit and the keyword below, e.g. "lebanon protest" or "r/lebanon protest".

list.noMatchesHint: Try a different search term or status filter.
